text:
maya_support: Escalation from AcmeMobile — iOS 3.4.2. Customer reports SSE stream disconnects during Wi‑Fi -> LTE handover. Final JSON object often truncated; app hangs waiting for close. Repro steps + logs below.

customer_jane: Repro steps they gave:
1) Open chat, start streaming generation
2) While streaming, toggle Wi‑Fi off (LTE takeover) within ~2–4s of stream start
3) Client receives partial event and never gets terminal chunk; UI spinner stays.
Attaching app log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T18:12:34Z] SSE RECV: data: {"id":"chat-xyz","delta":{"content":"Thanks"}
[2026-03-16T18:12:34Z] network: interface changed -> en0->pdp_ip0
[2026-03-16T18:12:34Z] SSE RECV: data: {"id":"chat-xyz","delta":{"content":"!"}}\n
[2026-03-16T18:12:34Z] parse_error: unexpected EOF while parsing JSON
```
They say it happens ~3–6% of streams during active transitions. Customer is on iOS VoIP-enabled app, TLS + SSE over our hosted API, API key auth.

sam_engineer: Thanks — I pulled server side traces for that customer (request id prefixes match). Edge shows upstream connection closed with TCP RST during the handoff window. Backend (runtime) did push the final event but the edge socket closed before the last bytes reached the client. Pattern: small final chunk plus trailing `\n\n` frequently missing on the wire.

diego_mobile: iOS-specific note — when an app switches from Wi‑Fi to cellular, the system can abort sockets (esp with VoIP sockets) and immediate RST is common. Client netstack may not get remaining bytes. Two mitigation angles: client should treat streaming JSON as stream-of-fragments and tolerate partial final object (recovery + retry), or server should make finalization more robust (e.g., explicit end-of-stream sentinel event before socket teardown).

maya_support: Customer's ask: 1) Is this a Redwood bug (shouldn't we guarantee final bytes?) 2) Any server-side config we can flip to reduce occurrences? They are worried about customer-facing UX (stuck spinner and billing concerns).

sam_engineer: Short answer: we can't make TCP guarantee delivery once the ISP/network issues RST the socket on client side. But we can reduce the failure surface. Ideas:
- Ensure streaming-gateway flushes buffers and emits an explicit SSE terminal event like `data: [DONE]\n\n` BEFORE initiating connection close. That increases chance the client gets a terminal token even if next step RSTs.
- Enable periodic small keepalive pings (every 1s) so handoffs see some traffic; but that has cost/tns impact.
- Make the runtime idempotent at message-level so client reconnect + resume can fetch last token offset.

diego_mobile: For iOS SDK workaround: on parse error, treat last_chunk_received flag as "partial" and attempt a fast resume using /events?after=<last_event_id> or simple reconnect with Range-like param. Client to show short "Reconnecting…" state instead of spinner indefinitely.

maya_support: Can we flip the `emit_terminal_event_on_close` feature flag on for hosted customers? Is there a quick patch we can roll to streaming-gateway?

sam_engineer: I created a tiny patch to gateway that ensures a final `data: [DONE]\n\n` is written and flushed in the socket close path. Patch: gateway/#4892. I can canary it for this customer only. Risk: in edge cases double-[DONE] if client reconnects quickly. Low risk.

incidents_bot: [incident-log] created INC-2026-042 — stream-truncation-on-handoff. Severity: P2 (customer-facing stuck UI, partial data loss). Assigned to eng-runtime.

maya_support: Action items:
- sam_engineer to deploy gateway/#4892 to canary zone for AcmeMobile (48h) — due EOD PST today.
- diego_mobile to provide SDK patch guidance for robust parse/retry (customer-facing fix) — small note for mobile team.
- support to enable debug logs (edge+gateway) for AcmeMobile for 72h.
- update customer with workaround: short reconnect UX + retry on parse error.

customer_jane: Thanks — can you also add a toggle flag we can control from console per-customer? We'll need to roll back quickly if it increases duplicate events.

sam_engineer: I'll expose it as `stream.final_event_on_close` per-tenant toggle. Will add basic dedupe token on the client to ignore duplicate `[DONE]` events.

diego_mobile: I'll draft iOS SDK snippet:
```
// on SSE parse error -> attempt quick reconnect
if (parseError && lastEventId) { reconnect(after: lastEventId, timeout: 2s) }
```
Also recommend showing "Connection briefly interrupted" instead of infinite spinner.

maya_support: I'll send roadmap + timeline to AcmeMobile. Can we confirm metrics to watch? Sam: increase in partial-parse errors from their API key, success rate pre/post. Diego: client-side parse-fail counts.

sam_engineer: Confirmed. I'll produce a short dashboard widget and post numbers in this thread after canary.

customer_jane: Appreciated. Please keep me posted — major client impact for our field reps.

sam_engineer: Canary deploy started — attaching job id: deploy-rt-2026-03-16-22-07 (rolling to 3 edge hosts for customer). Monitoring hooks set.

maya_support: Thanks all. Will follow up when canary metrics available. :thumbsup:
